#| results: 'asis'

library(knitr)
outputdir <- "/home/ethan/Dropbox/data/ocean/seaflow-40-bins"
cruisenames <- c("SCOPE_16", "MGL1704")
for (cruise in cruisenames) {
  cat("### ", cruise, "\n\n", sep = "")

  img <- file.path(
    outputdir, cruise,
    paste0(cruise, "-gridded-before-cleaning.png")
  )

  img_path <- knitr::include_graphics(img)

  cat(
    sprintf(
      '<img src="%s" style="width:100%%;">',
      img_path
    )
  )

  cat("\n\n")
}
